booking_passengers_check.name: booking_passengers_check
booking_passengers_check.value: ("booking_passengers"."mode"='SELF' AND "booking_passengers"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "booking_passengers"."account_id"="booking_passengers"."booker_user_id") OR ("booking_passengers"."mode"='OTHER' AND "booking_passengers"."account_id" IS NULL)

bookings_check.name: bookings_check
bookings_check.value: ("bookings"."status"='CONFIRMED' AND "bookings"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."confirmed_at">="bookings"."created_at") OR ("bookings"."status"<>'CONFIRMED' AND "bookings"."confirmed_at" IS NULL)

membership_company_role.name: membership_company_role
membership_company_role.value: ("memberships"."role" = 'SUPER_ADMIN' AND "memberships"."company_id" IS NULL) OR ("memberships"."role" IN ('ADMIN_PO','CREW') AND "memberships"."company_id" IS NOT NULL)

payment_events_check.name: payment_events_check
payment_events_check.value: ("payment_events"."status" IN ('PROCESSED','IGNORED') AND "payment_events"."processed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("payment_events"."status" IN ('RECEIVED','REVIEW') AND "payment_events"."processed_at" IS NULL)

payments_check.name: payments_check
payments_check.value: ("payments"."status"='PAID' AND "payments"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("payments"."status"<>'PAID' AND "payments"."paid_at" IS NULL)

payments_check1.name: payments_check1
payments_check1.value: ("payments"."creation_state"='READY' AND "payments"."snap_token" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."snap_redirect_url" IS NOT NULL) OR "payments"."creation_state"<>'READY'

route_stop_offsets.name: route_stop_offsets
route_stop_offsets.value: ("route_stops"."arrival_offset_min" IS NULL OR "route_stops"."arrival_offset_min" BETWEEN 0 AND 10080) AND ("route_stops"."departure_offset_min" IS NULL OR "route_stops"."departure_offset_min" BETWEEN 0 AND 10080) AND ("route_stops"."arrival_offset_min" IS NULL OR "route_stops"."departure_offset_min" IS NULL OR "route_stops"."arrival_offset_min"<="route_stops"."departure_offset_min")

hold_times.name: hold_times
hold_times.value: "seat_holds"."base_expires_at"="seat_holds"."created_at"+interval '10 minutes' AND "seat_holds"."effective_expires_at">="seat_holds"."base_expires_at" AND ("seat_holds"."payment_initiated_at" IS NULL OR "seat_holds"."payment_initiated_at">="seat_holds"."created_at")

hold_state.name: hold_state
hold_state.value: ("seat_holds"."status" IN ('ACTIVE','CONVERTED') AND "seat_holds"."released_at" IS NULL AND "seat_holds"."expired_at" IS NULL) OR ("seat_holds"."status"='RELEASED' AND "seat_holds"."released_at" IS NOT NULL AND "seat_holds"."released_at">="seat_holds"."created_at" AND "seat_holds"."expired_at" IS NULL) OR ("seat_holds"."status"='EXPIRED' AND "seat_holds"."expired_at" IS NOT NULL AND "seat_holds"."expired_at">="seat_holds"."effective_expires_at" AND "seat_holds"."released_at" IS NULL)

seat_cell_code_type.name: seat_cell_code_type
seat_cell_code_type.value: ("seat_template_cells"."type"='SEAT' AND "seat_template_cells"."seat_code" IS NOT NULL AND "seat_template_cells"."seat_code" ~ '^[A-Z0-9-]{1,8}$') OR ("seat_template_cells"."type"<>'SEAT' AND "seat_template_cells"."seat_code" IS NULL)

trip_crew_revocation.name: trip_crew_revocation
trip_crew_revocation.value: ("trip_crew_assignments"."status"='ACTIVE' AND "trip_crew_assignments"."revoked_at" IS NULL) OR ("trip_crew_assignments"."status"='REVOKED' AND "trip_crew_assignments"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

trip_seat_values.name: trip_seat_values
trip_seat_values.value: "trip_seats"."row_index" BETWEEN 0 AND 29 AND "trip_seats"."col_index" BETWEEN 0 AND 7 AND "trip_seats"."seat_code" ~ '^[A-Z0-9-]{1,8}$'

trip_publication_state.name: trip_publication_state
trip_publication_state.value: ("trips"."status"='DRAFT' AND "trips"."published_at" IS NULL AND "trips"."layout_snapshot" IS NULL AND "trips"."identity_snapshot" IS NULL) OR ("trips"."status"='OPEN_FOR_SALE' AND "trips"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "trips"."layout_snapshot" IS NOT NULL AND "trips"."identity_snapshot" IS NOT NULL)
